At last, it's time for Special Week's
Debut Race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-aaah!? Ah, I-I'm so sorry!
I just got a little overwhelmed by the atmosphere here...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But... this is no time to be getting nervous,
is it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The first step toward becoming the 'Best Umamusume in Japan'...
I'm gonna take it with all I've got!!
